guidance.bestFor: The minimal anatomy: a title and a one line description in the header part, with no body or actions

whenNotToUse.when: A panel where the user flips switches and drags a slider

guidance.bestFor: One trigger per side in a button grid, each opening a narrow panel on that side to compare placements
agentNotes: The base `sides` list adds `inline-start` and `inline-end`, logical sides that follow text direction, which the radix `PopoverContent` does not accept

whenNotToUse.when: Sliding the panel along one edge of the trigger rather than changing the edge

guidance.bestFor: A Dimensions header over 2 inline label and input rows for width and height, with no submit button
agentNotes: Both `Input` fields are uncontrolled with a `defaultValue` and nothing reads them; add state or a submit handler to apply the values

whenNotToUse.when: Settings changed with switches and a slider rather than typed values

guidance.bestFor: A row of 3 small buttons whose auto width panels line up with the start, center or end of their trigger

whenNotToUse.when: Moving the panel to another side of the trigger, such as above or to the left

guidance.bestFor: A second layer nested in an open modal: a button in the modal body opens a title and description panel
agentNotes: The `Dialog` and its Open Dialog trigger only host the demo; place the `Popover` inside your own `DialogContent`

whenNotToUse.when: A modal holding a short form, with no floating panel opened inside it

guidance.bestFor: A person chip with avatar, name and handle that opens a bio card with follower counts and a Follow button
agentNotes: Name, handle and the `AvatarImage` photo are hardcoded in both the trigger and the card; read them, the bio and the counts from one user record
The Follow `Button` has no handler, so it does nothing until you wire your follow action

whenNotToUse.when: A profile preview that opens as the pointer rests on a name

guidance.bestFor: A feature pitch with a primary tinted header bar, a short explainer and Enable AI and Learn more buttons
agentNotes: Enable AI and Learn more are plain `Button` elements with no handlers; wire the opt in and point Learn more at your docs

guidance.bestFor: An edge to edge 16:9 image that zooms on hover, above a template name, a one line summary and 2 action buttons
agentNotes: The `img` loads a placeholder grayscale photo from picsum.photos; set `src`, `alt` and the template copy to your own
Learn more is a `Button` whose `aria-label` reads View demo in new tab yet opens nothing; make it a link or match the label

name: c-popover-9
title: Relative time popover with timezone details
label: Relative Time
description: Relative time popover with timezone details

guidance.bestFor: A relative time inside a sentence, behind a dashed underline, that opens exact dates and clock times updating each second
agentNotes: `referenceTime` is always 2 hours before `now`, so pass your real deploy timestamp in its place
The row badged UTC goes through date-fns `format`, which prints local time; convert it before showing it as UTC
`now` reads the clock in `useState` during render, so a server rendered page hydrates with other seconds; set it after mount

whenNotToUse.when: Exact deploy times revealed while the pointer rests on the label
A field where the user picks an hour and minute rather than reads them

guidance.bestFor: An icon only settings button opening 2 labeled switches and a volume slider with a live percent readout
agentNotes: Both `Switch` toggles are uncontrolled and `volume` stays in local state; connect all 3 to your settings store
The icon only `PopoverTrigger` has no accessible name; add an aria-label such as Quick settings

whenNotToUse.when: Values typed into labeled text inputs, such as a width and a height

guidance.bestFor: A 4 step tour opening above its button, with a step counter and back and next arrows that stop at either end
agentNotes: Replace `steps` with your tour; the last step only disables the next arrow and offers no finish action
`currentStep` lives outside the `Popover`, so reopening resumes the last step seen; reset it on close to restart the tour
